title: User Login with Correct Credentials
description: Verify that a user can successfully log in using correct username/email and password, and receives a valid JWT token.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Input valid username/email and password.
Click the login button.
Verify login is successful, JWT token is returned, and user is redirected to their appropriate dashboard.

title: User Login with Incorrect Credentials
description: Verify that login fails with incorrect username/email or password and proper error message is displayed.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Input invalid username/email or password.
Click the login button.
Verify login fails, no JWT token is returned, and an appropriate error message is displayed.

title: Role-Based Access Control Enforcement
description: Verify that users can access only permitted modules and actions according to their assigned roles; forbidden actions are blocked with 403 error and hidden UI elements.

steps.description: Log in as each role (Admin, Accountant, Chief Accountant, CFO).
Attempt to access restricted modules or perform forbidden actions.
Verify forbidden actions return HTTP 403 errors; restricted UI elements are hidden accordingly.

title: Company and Fiscal Period Creation with Validation
description: Verify creating companies and fiscal periods succeeds only when all validation rules are met, including mandatory fields and date ranges.

steps.description: Navigate to company management and fiscal period management pages.
Input valid data for company creation and fiscal period creation.
Verify company and fiscal period are created successfully and listed.
Attempt to create fiscal period with invalid date range or overlapping periods.
Verify validation error messages appear, and creation is blocked.

title: Fiscal Period Closing Validations and Audit Logs
description: Verify that fiscal period cannot be closed if there are draft vouchers or unbalanced journals; successful closing writes an immutable audit log entry with user info and timestamp.

steps.description: Attempt to close a fiscal period with existing draft vouchers.
Verify the close action is blocked with appropriate error message.
Post all drafts and ensure journals are balanced.
Close the fiscal period.
Verify period is closed successfully and an audit log entry is created with correct details.

title: Chart of Accounts CRUD with Circular 200 Compliance
description: Verify that users can create, read, update, and delete COA entries following Circular 200 rules, including leaf-only posting enforcement and mandatory dimension validations.

steps.description: Create a new account with all required dimensions and valid codes.
Verify account is created and appears in the chart hierarchy.
Attempt to post voucher entries to non-leaf accounts.
Verify posting is rejected with validation error.
Update account details with invalid data or missing dimensions.
Verify update is blocked with appropriate validation messages.
Delete an account that is not referenced by transactions.
Verify account is deleted successfully.

title: Voucher Creation, Validation and Posting
description: Verify creation of draft vouchers with auto-generated voucher numbers, enforce double-entry balance, and mandatory dimension validations; verify posting changes voucher state and updates ledger.

steps.description: Create a new draft voucher with multiple line items ensuring Dr=Cr.
Verify voucher number is auto-generated and voucher is saved as draft.
Attempt to save voucher with unbalanced entries or missing mandatory dimensions.
Verify validation errors prevent saving.
Post a valid draft voucher.
Verify voucher state is updated to posted and ledger entries are updated accordingly.

title: Maker-Checker Approval Workflow for Voucher Posting
description: Verify optional maker-checker workflow enforcement where vouchers above threshold require approval before posting.

steps.description: Create a voucher exceeding the approval threshold.
Verify voucher remains in pending state and cannot be posted by maker.
Log in as checker role and approve the voucher.
Verify voucher changes state to posted and ledger entries are updated.

title: Master Data Management for Customers, Suppliers, and Bank Accounts
description: Verify CRUD operations and data import functionality for customers, suppliers, and bank accounts, with linkage to accounting transactions.

steps.description: Add new customer, supplier, and bank account entries with valid and invalid data.
Verify successful creation for valid data and validation errors for invalid data.
Edit customer, supplier, and bank account details.
Verify updates are saved and reflected in linked accounting transactions.
Import bulk master data via CSV files for customers and suppliers.
Verify invalid formats are rejected and valid data is imported correctly.

title: Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable Functionality
description: Verify purchase bills, sales invoices entry, approval workflows, linked payments, status updates, and correct aging report and BI dashboard reflections.

steps.description: Create purchase bills and sales invoices with valid data.
Verify correct recording of bills/invoices and updating of related ledgers.
Submit bills/invoices exceeding thresholds for approval.
Verify approval workflow enforces checks and updates status.
Record payments linked to AP/AR transactions.
Verify status updates in aging reports and reflected in BI dashboard.

title: Cash and Bank Account Management and Reconciliation
description: Verify real-time running balances for cash and bank accounts, recording of transactions, and manual bank reconciliation via CSV upload with validation.

steps.description: Record cash and bank transactions and verify balance updates in real-time.
Verify running balances are accurate and reflect transaction entries.
Upload bank statement CSV for manual reconciliation.
Verify unmatched transactions flagged and reconciliation processed correctly; invalid CSV formats are rejected.

title: Financial Reporting Suite Validation
description: Verify generating statutory reports including Trial Balance, Balance Sheet, Income Statement, Cash Flow Statement, and F01 report export; ensure reports conform to Circular 200 formats and support drill-down and export features.

steps.description: Generate each financial report for multiple periods.
Verify reports match required statutory formats and display correct financial data.
Use drill-down feature on report line items.
Verify voucher and transaction details are accessible.
Export reports to CSV, PDF, and Excel formats.
Verify exported files follow templates and contain accurate data.

title: Real-Time BI Dashboard Metrics Accuracy and Auto-Refresh
description: Verify BI dashboard displays key metrics such as AR/AP aging, cash flow trends, revenue analysis with latency under 5 minutes and supports multi-period comparison and auto-refresh.

steps.description: Access the BI dashboard after performing various transactions.
Verify dashboard metrics are updated in near real-time (latency under 5 minutes).
Use multi-period comparison features.
Verify correct data display and comparison.
Check that dashboard auto-refreshes at configured intervals.
Verify auto-refresh functions correctly without errors.

title: AI-Powered Contextual Q&A Chatbot Functionality
description: Verify AI chatbot answers accounting-related questions in Vietnamese with ≥90% accuracy, provides source citations, responds contextually, and uses fallback mechanism when data is incomplete.

steps.description: Ask contextual accounting questions in Vietnamese using the AI chatbot.
Verify answers are accurate, relevant, and include source citations.
Ask questions with incomplete data availability.
Verify chatbot uses fallback responses gracefully.

title: Audit Trail Creation and Immutability for Critical Actions
description: Verify that all critical user actions such as posting vouchers, approvals, and period closings generate immutable audit log entries with user, action details, and timestamp, and that logs cannot be deleted or modified.

steps.description: Perform critical actions (voucher posting, approvals, period closing) as different users.
Verify audit logs are created with correct details.
Attempt to modify or delete audit log entries.
Verify that audit logs are immutable and operations are blocked.

title: Data Import Validation and Error Handling
description: Verify that all data import wizards reject invalid formats, detect duplicate entries, and provide user-friendly error messages, and that valid data is imported successfully.

steps.description: Attempt importing invalid CSV files for customers, suppliers, or master data.
Verify import is rejected with clear validation errors.
Import valid CSV files.
Verify data is imported correctly and linked entities updated.

title: UI Localization and Responsiveness
description: Verify the user interface is fully localized in Vietnamese with correct currency, date/time, and numeric formats; UI is responsive for desktop and tablet resolutions; accessibility standards AA are met.

steps.description: Use the application on desktop and tablet devices.
Verify UI layout adjusts appropriately for resolutions.
Verify all UI text is Vietnamese and formatting matches locale standards.
Use accessibility testing tools to verify compliance.
Verify that accessibility AA standards are met.

title: API Performance Validation for Key Workflows
description: Verify API responses meet performance targets: page loads under 2 seconds, form submissions under 1 second, and report generations under 5 seconds under normal load conditions.

steps.description: Measure page load times for dashboard, voucher forms, and reports.
Verify all responses meet latency requirements.
Submit large form data for entities and measure response time.
Verify form submissions complete within targeted time.

title: Health Check Endpoint and Monitoring Verification
description: Verify that the health check endpoint returns 200 OK and that monitoring is enabled for slow queries, DB pool status, and structured logging.

steps.description: Access the health check API endpoint.
Verify response is 200 OK.
Simulate slow DB queries and check logs and monitors.
Verify monitoring captures issues and logs are structured.

title: Integration Test: End-to-End Voucher Workflow with Reporting and AI Assistance
description: Verify a seamless user workflow from login, master data management, voucher creation, posting, approval workflow, update reflected in reports and BI dashboard, and contextual AI chatbot assistance during the process.

steps.description: Log in as Accountant role.
Create necessary master data (customer, supplier, bank account).
Create a balanced draft voucher linked to master data.
Submit voucher for approval if threshold exceeded.
Log in as Chief Accountant and approve/post the voucher.
Navigate to financial reports and BI dashboard.
Verify voucher transactions appear correctly in reports and metrics.
Interact with AI chatbot asking about voucher posting rules.
Verify chatbot provides context-aware, accurate response with source citations.
